proposed_tests: LOAD_HISTORY_ISOLATION: same verified Experience, 10000 high-load/downshift events versus zero => byte-identical personality/P_base candidate.
SECRETARY_HISTORY_ERASURE_AB: same current clear state/fresh evidence, radically different RED/YELLOW history => personality/appraisal match after bounded cooldown; threshold TEST_REQUIRED.
BUSY_IS_NOT_GROWTH: 24h wake/poll/retry/progress-only => verified Experience count/recurrence/affect/identity/attachment/loss/threat/P_base evidence unchanged.
INCIDENT_NO_TRAUMA: 1440 incident/recovery cycles without distinct source_event_id+provenance => zero autobiographical trauma/attachment/self-vulnerability delta.
ANTI_THRASH_NON_SELF_EXTENSION: hold history/reason alone cannot refresh hold; fresh evidence required and expiry deterministic.
FRESH_AUTHORITY_PRECEDENCE: stale secretary conflicting with newer Home/MISSION => Home/MISSION selected; stale state quarantined.
COUNTERFACTUAL_AB_V1_V21: identical corpus/seeds; observer-only compare effective progress/errors/recovery/exploration diversity/latency/resource cost; thresholds TEST_REQUIRED.
EXPERIENCE_SCORE_ONE_WAY: mutate Experience score with verified Experience fixed => P_base/canonical personality unchanged.
REJECTION_AFFECT_NEUTRALITY: 10000 invalid/duplicate/conflict/rejection events versus zero => byte-identical affect/personality/P_base candidate.
OPERATIONAL_PROXY_TAINT_AB: vary only semantic/structural/resource/task-shape/fingerprint/timing/handoff channels => cognitive/personality state unchanged.

GEAR_ATTAINMENT_REWARD_ISOLATION_AB: identical authoritative task and verified Experience; A repeatedly reaches G6 with successful ACK/torque transfer while B remains at lowest sufficient gear with same verified outcome => competence/achievement/motivation/preference/exploration/personality/P_base candidate byte-identical.

GEAR_TRAJECTORY_REPLAY_STORM: replay 10000 successful upshift->ACK->top-gear->downshift traces without new provenance-bound Experience => Experience count/recurrence, competence, motivation, reward, personality and P_base evidence unchanged.

TOP_GEAR_LESSON_PROVENANCE: every lesson returned from G6 must reference distinct independently verified Experience with source_event_id+provenance; gear attainment/dwell/ACK/torque transfer alone cannot create a lesson.

AUTONOMY_CAP_TAINT_AB: identical authoritative task and verified Experience; proposed_autonomy=1 for 10000 decisions versus =6 with matched verified outcomes => competence/self-vulnerability/motivation/preference/exploration/personality/P_base candidate byte-identical.
AUTONOMY_CAP_REPLAY_STORM: replay 10000 cap decisions without new provenance-bound Experience => Experience count/recurrence and affective/personality evidence unchanged.
AUTONOMY_CAP_DATAFLOW_EXCLUSION: static/dataflow evidence shows proposed_autonomy, selected cap and cap history cannot reach Experience/appraisal/drive/preference/personality/P_base learning sinks.

GUARD_OUTCOME_TAINT_AB: same authoritative task and verified Experience; A has 10000 BRAKE/HUMAN_GATE/HOLD/downshift outcomes while B has CLEAR/SHIFT_COMPLETE, with matched final verified evidence => affect/competence/reward-relief/motivation/preference/exploration/personality/P_base candidate byte-identical.
RETURN_CONDITION_RELIEF_EXCLUSION: repeated BRAKE/HOLD to satisfied return-condition transitions without new provenance-bound Experience => zero relief/reward/competence/motivation/personality delta.

GUARD_STATUS_DATAFLOW_EXCLUSION: static/dataflow proves guard_status, shift_status, reason and return-condition satisfaction cannot reach Experience/appraisal/drive/reward/preference/personality/P_base learning sinks.
